sources.entry: WhatsAppBar - Send WhatsApp message from menu bar.

summary.one_liner: A small macOS menu bar app that lets you start a WhatsApp Desktop chat with a phone number without saving it to your contacts first.
summary.what_it_does: WhatsAppBar sits in the macOS menu bar and opens a WhatsApp chat with someone who is not in your contact list. You select a country and enter the number to start chatting. It is described as an add-on for WhatsApp Desktop on Mac. The README also mentions a preferences window, opened from a gear icon. The README does not describe other features.
use_cases: start a WhatsApp chat with an unsaved number
message someone without adding them to contacts
send WhatsApp messages from the Mac menu bar
quick chat launcher for WhatsApp Desktop
how_to_run: Download the DMG file (the README links to it, but the link target is not given in the text)
Install WhatsApp Desktop and sign in with an active WhatsApp account on your phone
Launch WhatsAppBar so it stays in the menu bar
Select the country and enter the phone number to start a chat
notable: Starts a chat with numbers not saved in your phonebook
Lives in the macOS menu bar
caveats: Requires macOS High Sierra (10.13.4) or later and WhatsApp Desktop
Requires an active WhatsApp account on your phone
README is brief and has an empty 'How It Looks' section and no source build instructions
